prompt:
The section sections/how-it-works-trimmed.liquid renders a "How it works" list of steps. Merchants paste content with stray spaces, tabs and newlines, so empty-looking headings and steps still show up. Update the markup to trim whitespace. Keep the existing {% schema %} block, and the comment line just before it, byte-for-byte. Inputs (all nested under `section`): - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.blocks: array (possibly empty) of blocks in display order. Each block has block.settings.title (string or null) and block.settings.text (string or null). Required output. No whitespace may appear between any tags. Output exactly: `
` + optional heading + `
    ` + steps + `
`. Rules: 1. Heading: strip leading and trailing whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines) from the heading. Treat null as an empty string. If the result is non-empty, output `

HEADING

` using the stripped, HTML-escaped value. Otherwise output no h2. 2. Steps: process each block in order. Strip the title, treating null as an empty string. If the stripped title is empty, output nothing for that block. Otherwise output `

  • TITLE

    ` + optional paragraph + `
    • `, where TITLE is the stripped, HTML-escaped title. 3. Paragraph: strip the text, treating null as an empty string. If the result is non-empty, output `

    TEXT

    ` (stripped, HTML-escaped) right after the h3. Otherwise output no p element. 4. HTML escaping must turn & < > " into & < > ". 5. When there are no blocks, or every block is skipped, the list is still output as `
      `. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/how-it-works-trimmed.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
